name: Wicked Love
source:
The player controls Eerie Bones, an eccentric human woman with plenty of moxie who mysteriously wakes up in the captivating underworld city of Tartarus, a city divided into 7 different districts, each one is heavily plagued by a different sin. Without knowing how or why she ended up in Tartarus, Eerie finds out she must collect the Seven Seals to return home. You will decide Eerie's destiny as you make difficult choices, solve puzzles, and develop relationships with the denizens of Tartarus.

[From [url=https://spiritkinder.itch.io/wicked-love-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玩家控制的是Eerie Bones，一个性格古怪、胆量十足的人类女性，她在迷人的黑社会塔尔塔罗斯神秘地醒来，这座城市分为7个不同的区域，每个区域都受到不同罪恶的严重困扰。在不知道自己如何或为何来到塔耳塔洛斯的情况下，伊莉发现她必须收集七封印才能回家。当你做出艰难的选择、解决谜题并与塔尔塔罗斯的居民发展关系时，你将决定怪诞的命运。

[来自[url=https://spiritkinder.itch.io/wicked-love-demo]itch.io[/url]]
